premise: On its long voyage the probe passes an asteroid; the telescope watches, the satellite brings back the close-up — and the asteroid has a tiny moon of its own.
inspiration: Homer's Odyssey (the wonders met on a long voyage), turned: the wonder is a lumpy rock with a friend.
learning: Some asteroids have little moons of their own.

en-US.title: The Far Traveller
en-US.text: {probe:enter} The probe had been travelling for months, and it had years still to go. Today it had company: an {asteroid:enter} asteroid, tumbling through the dark. {asteroid:live hold} Lumpy. Grey. {asteroid:pulse} Very, very old. {telescope:enter} Far away, the space telescope {telescope:live} turned its golden mirror to watch. [whispers] Closer… closer… {probe:live} The probe turned slowly, pointing its cameras. Click. Click. Click. {satellite:enter} The pictures went racing back across space, and the satellite {satellite:live} passed them down to the base. [gasps] There it was, up close: craters, boulders, a dusty grey skin. And going round and round it — {telescope:pulse} what was that? {asteroid:live resume} [excited] A tiny moon! The asteroid had a little moon of its own. {all:face surprised} {all:sparkle} Even out there, nobody travels alone.

es-ES.title: El viajero lejano
es-ES.text: {probe:enter} La sonda llevaba meses viajando, y aún le quedaban años. Ese día tuvo compañía: un {asteroid:enter} asteroide, dando tumbos en la oscuridad. {asteroid:live hold} Abollado. Gris. {asteroid:pulse} Viejísimo. {telescope:enter} Muy lejos, el telescopio espacial {telescope:live} giró su espejo dorado para mirar. [whispers] Más cerca… más cerca… {probe:live} La sonda giró despacio, apuntando sus cámaras. Clic. Clic. Clic. {satellite:enter} Las fotos cruzaron el espacio a toda velocidad, y el satélite {satellite:live} se las pasó a la base. [gasps] Allí estaba, de cerca: cráteres, rocas, una piel gris y polvorienta. Y dando vueltas a su alrededor… {telescope:pulse} ¿qué era eso? {asteroid:live resume} [excited] ¡Una luna diminuta! El asteroide tenía su propia lunita. {all:face surprised} {all:sparkle} Ni siquiera allí fuera viaja nadie solo.
